title: The four continents of Aza'ra

continents.name: Tzaphaer
continents.note: Do not apply hypothetical modern epenthesis to this historically named continent.

continents.name: Belavados
continents.note: Final part sounds like the English doe plus s, not English does (/dʌz/). Accent ó is an author-suggested sound notation.

notes: These are four names given by the people of Uxrowo.
Belavados was destroyed by the Iron Dominion.
Iron Dominion is an approximate English translation; its Aza'raan equivalent is undecided.
Historical romanized names can retain U spelling; no independent modern U glyph exists.
A more modern hypothetical newly coined name would not retroactively change Tzaphaer's original pronunciation.
